items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returned to practice Friday after DNP Wed/Thu; second straight miss prior. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR.
items.implication: Upgrade if clears; reduces Bateman upside.
items.opportunity: Full WR1 routes/targets if active vs NO

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP second straight day Thu; unlikely available Sun vs LV. Worked side only.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-Week 1 exit; Harbaugh day-to-day earlier.
items.implication: Sit; Johnston/Harris route share spike (90%+ without him W1).

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring at Wed practice (history of multi-game miss in 2024); DNP Thu after MRI; ran 37/42 routes Week 1. Status for Sun vs CIN in jeopardy.
items.why: Hamstring pull history + DNP post-MRI; high route share indicates volume loss if out.
items.implication: Downgrade WR rankings; monitor Fri designation.

items.text: Bills ruled DJ Moore OUT TNF shoulder; AC joint sprain not serious, day-to-day, chance but not lock for next week vs LAC.
items.why: Ruled out mid-game; AC sprain confirmed.
items.implication: Missed W2 production; monitor for W3.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready to debut; unclear snap/carry share vs Rhamondre Stevenson. Perfect timing: AJ Brown IR, explosive need, strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc pre-bye).
items.why: Self-reported ready; Pats desperate for playmakers post-Brown IR.
items.implication: Handcuff/stash with role expansion potential; monitor usage.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thu (meniscus trim); yet to practice since surgery. Status uncertain vs LAC.
items.implication: Risk sit; Mayer fringe TE1 if out.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WR hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore (Lane IR).
items.why: Lane IR + Flowers DNP creates clear pecking order for targets.
items.implication: Bateman flex upside if Flowers OUT; reverse on return.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Also Vele (Tyson IR), etc.
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead, 24% share); IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare.
LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Dominant dual-threat usage Week 1 + soft run matchup.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; Bears allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: High share + historical chemistry + soft secondary.

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% tgt/13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1; TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to NYJ; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last yr.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes W1 (most pts via air); Kamara expected back squeezes role; NO 8.5 underdogs poor rush script.
items.why: Split + returning Kamara + negative game script.
